question.q: 12. Match List-I (Doab) with List-II (Rivers): A. Bist Doab B. Bari Doab C. Rachna Doab D. Chaj Doab | i. Between Ravi and Chenab ii. Between Ravi and Beas iii. Between Beas and Sutlej iv. Between Chenab and Jhelum
question.explanation: The correct matching is as follows— (Doab) Bist Doab Bari Doab – (Rivers)– Between the Beas and the Sutlej– Between the Ravi and the Beas Rachna Doab – Between the Ravi and the Chenab Chaj Doab – Between the Chenab and the Jhelum
